first.rationale: The simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most direct intervention, with two inherited memories supporting durable early-funnel gains. Verify memory_86 because it most closely matches the current problem and can clarify whether improved completion and time-to-value translated into qualified downstream revenue. Promotional pricing addresses the competitive threat but carries greater uncertainty around customer quality and long-term economics.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening and simplifying onboarding. The verified source showed completion +13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention +3%, directly matching the current onboarding and activation declines while providing evidence of downstream durability. Memory_31 independently supports simplified signup for SMB activation. Qualified-revenue impact was not measured directly, so the experiment should track retained activation, conversion, and revenue quality rather than optimize completion alone.
